description: Read how each of the business's own tools performed over a date range, one row per tool, busiest first: how many conversations called it, its mean latency, and its success, error and timeout rates (0 to 1; timeouts count as errors too). Only tools the business supplied are reported. thread_count counts a conversation once per day, so one that called the tool on three days counts three times. Figures are rolled up once a day, so the most recent day may still be incomplete. Known limitation: the range may span at most 30 days, counting both ends.

app_id.description: The 360dialog channel's app_id. Identifies which WhatsApp number the agent belongs to.

end_date.description: Last day to include, YYYY-MM-DD in the business time zone. Inclusive.

start_date.description: First day to include, YYYY-MM-DD in the business time zone. Inclusive.

tool_name.description: Return only this tool, named as it was registered. Omit for every tool called.

name: mba_get_tool_call_insights
title: Read tool call insights
